The '''Rancor forest''' was a small, heavily [[Forest/Legends|forested]] area on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] which a [[Unidentified rancor|Rancor]] used as their hunting grounds during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] defeated this [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] and tamed their child, [[Fogg]].<ref name="TCWA" />
